# Bookmarklets

Small browser tools for capturing site icons, generating passphrases, copying Halo ticket links, tidying Rhea and opening pages at a chosen window size.

**[Open the bookmarklet install page](https://danlibbo.github.io/bookmarklets/)** — drag a bookmarklet button from that page to your bookmarks bar.

The install link becomes available after GitHub Pages is enabled. This bundle assumes **danlibbo/bookmarklets**; if you use a different repo, update `owner` and `repository` in [catalog.json](catalog.json) and run `npm run build` before uploading.

## Bookmarklets

| Bookmarklet | Overview | Install |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ⬇ Logo Grab | Finds the current site's favicon or app icon, prioritises SVG and larger declared sizes, and downloads a square PNG. | [Install](https://danlibbo.github.io/bookmarklets/#logo-grab) |
| Passphrases | Creates a three-word passphrase with punctuation, varied initial capitalisation and a two-digit number, then copies it to the clipboard. | [Install](https://danlibbo.github.io/bookmarklets/#passphrases) |
| Halo link | Copies a formatted hyperlink to the open Halo ticket, using its ticket number and summary as the link text. | [Install](https://danlibbo.github.io/bookmarklets/#halo-link) |
| TidyRhea | Adds a collapse/expand button to Rhea's sidebar, giving forms more space and remembering the sidebar preference in this browser. | [Install](https://danlibbo.github.io/bookmarklets/#tidy-rhea) |
| 🪟 Window Resizer | Opens the current page in a new window at a preset size or custom width and height. | [Install](https://danlibbo.github.io/bookmarklets/#window-resizer) |

## Install

1. Show your browser's bookmarks bar. In Chrome or Edge on Windows, press **Ctrl + Shift + B**.
2. Open the install page above.
3. Drag the named bookmarklet button to the bookmarks bar.
4. Open the webpage you want to work on and click the saved bookmarklet.

**GitHub README limitation:** GitHub strips executable `javascript:` links from rendered Markdown. The README's Install links therefore open the relevant section of the HTML install page; drag the button there, rather than the README link. See [GitHub's bookmarklet issue](https://github.com/github/markup/issues/79).

**Without hosting:** download or clone the repo, open [docs/index.html](docs/index.html) locally in a browser and drag the buttons. Opening the HTML file in GitHub's code viewer does not render the installer.

**Manual installation:** use **Copy bookmarklet URL** on the install page, create or edit a bookmark, and paste into its URL/address field. Each [dist/*.bookmarklet.txt](dist/) file contains the same single-line URL. Paste into the bookmark editor, rather than the address bar, which may strip the `javascript:` prefix.

**Bulk installation:** import [bookmarks.html](bookmarks.html) through your browser's bookmark manager. It adds a folder containing all five bookmarklets; move them to your bookmarks bar if needed.

## Usage notes

### ⬇ Logo Grab

Open the website you want an icon from, then run Logo Grab. The PNG is named after the site's hostname.

Uses icons declared by the page, rather than searching page content for a brand logo. The PNG is at least 256 × 256 pixels; enlarging a small icon does not add detail. If CORS prevents export, it shows the original image for manual saving in its original format.

[Readable source](src/logo-grab.js) · [Bookmarklet URL](dist/logo-grab.bookmarklet.txt)

### Passphrases

Run on a normal webpage. A notification shows the generated passphrase; if copying fails, a prompt lets you copy it manually.

Retains the supplied wordlists, format and Math.random-based generation algorithm. Generates locally without a server request; the notification displays the passphrase on the current page for five seconds.

[Readable source](src/passphrases.js) · [Bookmarklet URL](dist/passphrases.bookmarklet.txt) · [Original project](https://github.com/danlibbo/passphraseGenerator)

### Halo link

Open a ticket in the Halo agent interface, run Halo link, then paste into an application that supports rich text, such as Outlook or Teams.

Requires the expected ticket number and summary elements and an id URL parameter. Plain-text destinations may discard the hyperlink formatting; Halo interface changes may require selector updates.

[Readable source](src/halo-link.js) · [Bookmarklet URL](dist/halo-link.bookmarklet.txt)

### TidyRhea

Open Rhea, run TidyRhea, then use the arrow button to toggle the sidebar. Running the bookmarklet again also toggles it.

Only runs on rhea.private.aus-1.datixcloudiq.com. The preference is stored in that site's local storage. Re-run after a full page reload to restore the control and saved preference.

[Readable source](src/tidy-rhea.js) · [Bookmarklet URL](dist/tidy-rhea.bookmarklet.txt)

### 🪟 Window Resizer

Run on the page you want to resize. Choose 1280 × 720, 1366 × 768 or 1920 × 1080, or enter custom dimensions.

Requests whole-window dimensions in CSS pixels, including the title bar and borders. Browser and operating-system limits may adjust the actual size. Allow pop-ups for the current site when prompted.

[Readable source](src/window-resizer.js) · [Bookmarklet URL](dist/window-resizer.bookmarklet.txt)

Bookmarklets run in the active webpage. Built-in browser pages, some document viewers and sites with restrictive content policies may prevent them from running. These tools use native browser APIs and do not load external scripts. Logo Grab requests the current site's declared icons and manifest.

## Publish the install page with GitHub Pages

1. Add this bundle's contents to your repo root and commit them to `main`.
2. In the repo, open **Settings → Pages**.
3. Under **Build and deployment**, set **Source** to **Deploy from a branch**.
4. Choose **main**, select the **/docs** folder, and click **Save**.
5. Wait for deployment to finish, then open the URL shown by GitHub.

The page consists of plain HTML with embedded CSS and JavaScript. No build workflow is needed for hosting: the generated files are already included. [GitHub Pages publishing instructions](https://docs.github.com/en/pages/getting-started-with-github-pages/configuring-a-publishing-source-for-your-github-pages-site).

## Maintain the repo

Requires **Node.js 20 or later** only when regenerating files. No package installation is required.

1. Edit a file in `src/` to change a bookmarklet.
2. Edit `catalog.json` to change names, descriptions or the repo address.
3. Run `npm run build` to update the README, install page, bookmark import file and encoded URLs.
4. Run `npm run check` to validate JavaScript syntax and verify that generated files match their sources.
5. Commit the source and generated files together. After code changes, users must re-drag or re-import affected bookmarklets; saved bookmarks do not update automatically.

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `README.md` | Overview, installation and maintenance instructions |
| `docs/index.html` | Self-contained page with draggable bookmarklet links and copy buttons |
| `docs/.nojekyll` | Serves the install page directly on GitHub Pages |
| `bookmarks.html` | Browser bookmark import file |
| `src/*.js` | Readable JavaScript for each bookmarklet |
| `dist/*.bookmarklet.txt` | Ready-to-paste, single-line bookmarklet URLs |
| `catalog.json` | Descriptions and GitHub repo address |
| `scripts/build.mjs` | Dependency-free generator and consistency check |
| `package.json` | Build and check shortcuts |
| `CHANGES.md` | Small corrections made while packaging the supplied code |

The Passphrases bookmarklet is a local copy of the supplied code associated with [passphraseGenerator](https://github.com/danlibbo/passphraseGenerator); it is not automatically synchronised with that project. Its wordlists and generation algorithm are retained.
